plan.summary:
This PR lets the cache size be set with the `CACHE_MB` environment variable.

- `cacheConfig` parses `env.CACHE_MB` with `Number`.
- It uses the value only when it is finite and greater than 0.
- Otherwise it keeps `DEFAULT_MEGABYTES`.
plan.riskRationale: A small change in one function. Bad input falls back to the old default. The cache size changes only when CACHE_MB holds a valid positive number.
plan.storyArc: One change: `cacheConfig` reads `CACHE_MB` and falls back to the default when the value is not valid.

topics.title: Cache size read from CACHE_MB with a safe fallback
topics.narrativeBrief: How does `cacheConfig` choose `megabytes` now? Check that a missing, non-numeric, zero, negative, or infinite `CACHE_MB` falls back to `DEFAULT_MEGABYTES`. Verify that `Number(undefined)` gives NaN, and note that an empty string gives 0; both fall back.
